YAG optional media slots (all files remain external to dist/index.html)

BOOT WORDMARK (font has priority when present; SVG is the fallback)
  public/brand/boot-logo.svg           exact white vector wordmark
  public/brand/boot-subtitle.svg       optional subtitle artwork
  public/fonts/PS4-Logo.otf            font used to typeset "YAG"
  public/fonts/YAG-Boot-Display.woff2  display font used to typeset "YAG"
  public/fonts/YAG-Boot-Display.ttf    TrueType alternative

XMB TYPEFACE
  public/fonts/SCE-PS3-Rodin-LATIN.woff2
  public/fonts/SCE-PS3-Rodin-LATIN.ttf

XMB ICONS (optional; the built-in vector set is used when a slot is empty)
  public/icons/xmb/home.svg          category and item glyphs, named after the
  public/icons/xmb/gateway.svg        icon key (home, explore, protocols,
                                     engineering, operations, project, gateway,
                                     information, connections, topology, trace,
                                     protocol, routing, source, shield, status,
                                     download, configuration, monitor,
                                     quickstart, user, link, contribute, profile)

AUDIO (all optional; missing files are skipped without console errors)
  public/audio/start.mp3         boot chime / startup tone
  public/audio/cursor.mp3        cursor navigation tick
  public/audio/select.mp3        selection
  public/audio/cancel.mp3        back / cancel
  public/audio/trophy.mp3        easter egg

Use only media you have the rights to deploy. The referenced PlayStation 3
system sounds and PS4 logo typeface are copyrighted third-party assets; this
repository intentionally ships neither. The XMB icon artwork shipped in
src/xmb/xmbIcons.ts comes from an MIT-licensed community pack and is credited
in third_party/xmb-icons.
